Section3's transport has partial_u J=D(u)J and partial_v J=-JD(v). Its coefficient recurrence C_(j+1)=C_j'+C_j D has the correct multiplication order for these conventions. The direction M_psi^T=J(psi,chi)M_chi^T is consistent with cohomological horizontality.
